76:t_003:3.en:
$$レド$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ is the Alliance's enemy.」

76:t_003:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「The $$人類銀河同盟$$ isn't here.」

76:t_003:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「What's the problem? If he's offering to help.」

76:t_003:7.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Exactly. We all help each other out in this world.」

76:t_003:9.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I surmise that phrase expresses the concept of mutual assistance.」

76:t_003:10.en:
$$レド$$
「There are an awful lot of words for mutual assistance.」

76:t_003:11.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I surmise this is a characteristic of this planet.」

76:t_003:12.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Perfect timing, $$レド$$! Try out the new weapon I made!」

76:t_003:13.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I call it the $$ピニオンハルバード$$! Give 'em hell!」

76:t_003:14.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Its effectiveness is questionable.」

76:t_003:15.en:
$$レド$$
「Not necessarily. Judging by $c's other units, close combat is an effective tactic.」

76:t_003:16.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$スカル１$$ to all units! Our target is the enemy ship carrying $$ギルター$$!」

76:t_003:17.en:
$$オズマ$$
「We'll take him down and finish this fast!」

76:t_004:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Damn it! You insufferable bastards never stop!」

76:t_004:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I don't want to hear that from a coward like you!」

76:t_004:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Watch out, $$ガロード$$! Something's coming!」

76:t_006:0.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ reinforcements?」

76:t_006:1.en:
$$ルカ$$
「But they seem to have attacked $$ギルター$$'s unit as well as ours.」

76:t_006:2.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Watch out! Something else is coming!」

76:t_007:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s army and battle robots from $$ギシン星$$!」

76:t_007:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「An unwanted interruption today! Remember this, $c! The next time we meet will be your last!」

76:t_008:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「The enemy ship is withdrawing.」

76:t_008:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Dealing with $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s army takes priority now.」

76:t_008:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「What the hell's going on!? Those guys were still alive!?」

76:t_008:4.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Confirmed. The small saucers and battle robots from $$ギシン星$$ are all unmanned.」

76:t_008:6.en:
$$ボス$$
「Then did someone steal those $$サイデリアル$$ machines over there and start using them...!?」

76:t_008:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't know how this happened, but they have attacked us.」

76:t_008:8.en:
$n
「We have no choice but to intercept them.」

76:t_008:9.en:
$$クルツ$$
「But we're fighting back-to-back battles. This'll be rough.」

76:t_008:11.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All units, intercept the unidentified enemy force. But we don't know their objective, so don't overextend yourselves.」

76:t_008:12.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Ensign $$レド$$, I'm counting on your help, too.」

76:t_009:1.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It's okay, $$ティファ$$. I'm sure $$宗介$$ and $$ガロード$$ will take care of things.」

76:t_009:2.en:
$$ティファ$$
「Yes... And the moon will appear soon.」

76:t_009:3.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The moon...? There's still a while until nightfall...」

76:t_009:4.en:
$$ティファ$$
「That moon will be a light to shine through the darkness.」

76:t_009:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「A unit is approaching this area.」

76:t_009:7.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「That possibility is ruled out. Life signs confirmed aboard the approaching unit.」

76:t_010:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$勝平$$...! Is that you, $$勝平$$!?」

76:t_010:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「You bet! Long time no see, $$ワッ太$$!」

76:t_010:4.en:
$$恵子$$
「$$勝平$$! This is no time to reminisce!」

76:t_010:5.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「First, we're taking out the guys in front of us!」

76:t_010:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「Yeah, yeah, I know! You don't have to tell me!」

76:t_011:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Perfect. If you're fighting alone, give me and $$ザンボット$$ a hand.」

76:t_011:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Unit unidentified, but presumed friendly.」

76:t_011:2.en:
$$レド$$
「Understood. This unit will provide support.」

76:t_012:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'm counting on you, $$勝平$$! They're unmanned, so don't hold back!」

76:t_012:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「Leave it to me! It's been a while, so I'll show you what the great $$勝平$$ and $$ザンボット３$$ can do!」

76:t_012:2.en:
$n
「The pilot of that giant robot... Is he a friend of $$ワッ太$$'s?」

76:t_012:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「That's $$神勝平$$, and his robot is $$ザンボット３$$. He used to fight alongside us.」

76:t_012:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「So he was missing because he was on the $$翠の地球$$.」

76:t_012:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「Here I come, robot army! You're my warm-up before I fight $$サイデリアル$$!」

76:t_012:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「The great $$神勝平$$ and $$ザンボット３$$ will take you on!!」

76:t_013:0.en:
$$恵子$$
「We've defeated all the enemies. There don't seem to be any reinforcements nearby, either.」

76:t_013:1.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「We can breathe easy for now.」

76:t_013:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$正太郎$$... Those enemies today... Do you think...」

76:t_013:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Yeah... $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ might have come back to life...」

76:t_013:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Give me a break! $$サイデリアル$$'s already more than we can handle! If he shows up too, we're screwed!」

76:t_013:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「Don't worry, $$ワッ太$$, $$正太郎$$! Now that I'm here with $$ザンボット３$$, any enemy'll be a piece of cake!」

76:t_013:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Tch... You're still as cocky as ever.」

76:t_013:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「Hey! We haven't seen each other in ages, and that's what you say to me!?」
